scope: Current targeted frontier comparisons and unresolved decisions. Screening of 221 IDs is not completed global eligibility research. Applied exact decisions and preserved excluded assertions are in reviews/frontier-audit.json. No second graph baseline is included.
interpretation_rule: Applied units and current withdrawal decisions supersede preliminary screening recommendations. Keep-pending or unresolved is not a positive frontier certification. Temporary filenames retained inside exact evidence documents record provenance only; all accepted assertions, current decisions and the additional retained source bytes are available in this saved repository.

records.reason: Parallel-current force observation is a distinct result from needle deflection or induction; no same-result node identified.
Oxide-insulated field-effect control is distinct from bipolar planar processing, surface stabilization experiments and surface-state hypothesis.
Surface-state screening hypothesis is a scientific result, distinct from the later oxide-interface measurement and transistor devices.
Conductivity-changing granular contact detector differs from Hertz spark receiver and Marconi combined telegraphic systems.
Diffused p–n isolation differs materially from epoxy-filled physical channel isolation; do not collapse the Micrologic alternatives.
Physical channel isolation is a distinct circuit architecture from p–n isolation. Earliest sold Type F isolation remains unresolved; no identity merger.
Polysilicon gate and 3708 analog multiplexer represent process/material and functional changes, not another date for the original MOS demonstrator.
Continuous rotating-disc current generation differs from the two transient induction experiments.
Moving permanent magnet/coil induction is a distinct experimental configuration from transformer-ring switching; apparatus results are not duplicates.
Battery-switched two-winding iron ring tests induction without permanent magnet motion; distinct configuration from moving-magnet test.
Continuous electromagnetic mechanical rotation is distinct from the later induction generator and static force experiments.
Proposed dielectric-polarization test is a scientific question/formulation rather than the later Hertz apparatus or reflection observation.
Spatial interference/reflection evidence is a result beyond constructing the fast spark apparatus.
Fast oscillator/receiver apparatus differs from Branly resistive detection and Marconi telegraphic integration.

The conception node asserts the same retained-oxide architecture as the existing broadly defined planar-transistor node. Conception, prototype and circuit uptake are stages and applications of that configuration; preserve their dates and scopes separately. Noyce interconnection remains a distinct extension.
Broad retained-oxide planar configuration is the canonical target for its earlier conception. Product-specific 2N1613 remains separately scoped pending evidence about distinct product advance.
Single-chip CPU function and its merchant release form a configuration already broad enough to hold prototype/sale events; no further duplicate found.
Germanium phase-shift oscillator configuration differs from silicon planar flip-flop and interconnect concept; no identity merger.
Elevated conductor/earth connections add a stated architecture to ordinary Hertz–Branly tests.
Combines Hertz oscillator and Branly detector for telegraphic signs; new application/integration may qualify. Not a detector duplicate alone.
Field/displacement formulation is distinct from empirical induction observations or later radiation tests.
Metal conductors crossing oxide add monolithic interconnection functionality; not the same architecture as merely oxide-protected transistor junctions.
Needle deflection by circuit current is a distinct observation; its battery is an enabling apparatus rather than the same result.
Trough cells, connections and electrolyte differ from Volta’s literal pile; the alternate cups warrant comparison but exact identity is not established.
Selective diffusion blocking differs from retaining oxide for operational junction protection and from the pattern-transfer method.
Measured stable oxide/silicon interface behavior is a scientific result distinct from masking, planar device conception and MOS switching.
Photoresist pattern transfer adds precision/reproducibility to oxide window definition; not identical to oxide’s diffusion-blocking property.
Closely spaced gold contacts on germanium yield a distinct amplifier architecture from planar bipolar and oxide-gate devices.
Series electrochemical cells are not duplicate current-force observations; exact relationship with the later trough battery needs apparatus comparison.
The sold NPN model is a narrower product than the broadly defined retained-oxide configuration. Same architecture alone does not establish identical specifications/performance/cost; defer merger.
Product sale is supported but early sample isolation process unconfirmed. Cannot identify this configuration with either physical-isolation or junction-isolation prototype.
Color-dependent magnification compensation is a component mechanism distinct from objective chromatic correction and new bulk glass formulations.
Basic refractory lining and phosphorus removal distinguish it from the earlier air-conversion process.
Ore-extraction slag documents a different process from forging native copper or working meteoritic iron.
Air-driven oxidation/self-heating conversion is distinct from oxygen-lance and phosphorus-removing variants.
Independent comparative microscope tests are scientific evidence, distinct from manufacturing objective/eyepiece configurations.
Practical Bessemer implementation may include blast/process-scale changes; source assertion alone does not establish an unchanged duplicate of the earlier converter.
Silicated lead borate and preparation/annealing are a material/process configuration, not the furnace installation or magneto-optic result.
Magnetic-field-dependent optical polarization rotation is a distinct discovered effect from making its glass specimen.
Top-blown oxygen converter is materially different from air Bessemer conversion; later soft-blowing parameters may add a separate improvement.
Hammering/rolling meteoritic iron differs from smelting copper or casting/decarburizing iron.
Native-metal forging avoids ore extraction and is distinct from Belovode smelting. Global novelty of the sampled artifact assemblage remains unproven.
Bulk supply of borate/phosphate glasses offers refractive-index/dispersion combinations distinct from research measurements and assembled objectives.
Composition–dispersion measurements are scientific selection knowledge, distinct from later material supply or assembled microscopes.
Production stage of LD may share soft-blowing architecture, but industrial scale/cost/throughput can matter; the exact global-frontier increment is unresolved.

Archaeological crucible interpretation differs from Qiwu’s textual account; neither exact recipe equality nor transmission is proved.

Trial/rebuild witness may belong under broad separate-condenser configuration, but replacement cylinder/parts and performance changes prevent exact-identity conclusion here.

Regnault-based numerical Carnot account and appendix are scientific results distinct from 1848 scale and 1851 dynamical heat theory.
Combining equivalence and reversible-engine reasoning changes the theoretical basis from the 1849 caloric account.
Precision cylinder is an output of boring technique and part of a rebuilt engine; its distinct numerical/performance advance is unresolved rather than assumed duplicate.
Old achromatic homogeneous-immersion optics differ from apochromatic objective series; catalogue withdrawal is lifecycle evidence for the same older product.
Section molds with ceramic core are a distinct casting architecture from metallurgical extraction routes and glass casting.
Mold-cast glass/bone inlay funerary object is supported by its curator, but no global technical novelty comparison or exact existing canonical glass target is established.
Excavation proves a fragmented white jar/lid deposited in M331. This is an artifact/burial event; neither its technical advance nor an identical canonical predecessor is established.
Four-part body mold plus separately molded neck/base is an explicit manufacturing configuration; not equivalent to casting glass or generic pilgrim vessels.
Indigo–palygorskite composite is a distinct material architecture from glasses, metals and ceramic glazing; sampled use does not establish first synthesis.
Mold-blown sacred-material souvenir vessels are a distinct application, but earlier global vessel use and exact mechanism comparison remain open; no deletion target proved.
White high-fired body/colorless glaze differs from cobalt-painted Gongxian wares. Regional cargo evidence alone does not prove global production priority.
Cobalt decoration on high-fired white-slip body differs from undecorated Xing whiteware; precise relation to earlier global cobalt ceramic recipes remains unresolved.
Electrolytic aluminum production/supply differs from later kettle and engine-casting applications; availability alone is not proof of the first global electrolytic process.
Household aluminum cookware is a new material/application combination relative to ingot supply, but worldwide kettle/utensil precedents need checking; no exact canonical duplicate.
Aluminum engine-body use has weight/application implications distinct from cookware or bulk supply; globally earlier engine castings remain unassessed.
AD36 round molded radio cabinet is evidenced, but receiver styling/model date alone does not prove a new global Bakelite-cabinet architecture or application; no equivalent node target established.

Nylon filament material/processing is a component of the named toothbrush, not physically identical to the finished product. Existing record only bounds use by its sale; broader filament identity/novelty unresolved.
Named finished nylon-bristle application is distinct from producing filament. Curator calls it earliest nylon-bristle toothbrush, but primary sales/manufacturing comparison remains open.
Depicted geared saw and inferred crank/rod transmission differ in evidence/configuration from excavated multiblade workshops; earliest mechanism reconstruction retains uncertainty.

Multiple-blade workshop reconstruction could share a saw family with Ephesos, but apparatus/powertrain equality is not demonstrated; separate archaeological witnesses are unresolved for global qualification.
Workshop evidence/partly sawn blocks do not prove identical mechanism to Gerasa or Hierapolis; no geography-only deletion.
1315 copied folio is a documentary witness to the described earlier geared water-lift design; no separate copy-date invention should be inferred. No earlier canonical exact design target exists.
Canonical H4 architecture target can retain commissioned K1 copy as separately identified completion/use events without equating physical objects.

The holding institutions explicitly identify K1 as a commissioned copy of H4 for the same longitude-timekeeping application. No distinct cost, architecture, precision or application advance is asserted by the K1 records. Keep its 1769 completion and 1772–1775 voyage use as K1-scoped events; do not identify the two physical watches.
Explicit simplification of H4/K1 may change complexity/cost and is a distinct configuration; not eligible for K1-copy identity merge.

Practical admission cutoff/expansion predates the 1782 specification, but exact operating parameters/configuration comparison is unresolved; first use can be a stage of broader process rather than new frontier.
Separate-condenser water-returning engine has a factory-water application; mere larger engine/location cannot establish frontier. Preserve pending application/architecture comparison.
Two-cylinder compound expansion/equalizing mechanism differs from the one-cylinder double-acting Soho engine; do not conflate similarly named engines.

Late Newcomen atmospheric pumping deployment is likely an old architecture witness, but there is no canonical Newcomen node to receive it and exact design comparison is missing; unresolved, not deleted.
Change gearing synchronizing mandrel/leadscrew plus micrometer slide-rest feed is a specified precision configuration, distinct from engine-driven lathes in general.
Integrated sequential production system is distinct from a single machine/component and from general steam-powered workshop tools.

Primary object catalogue proves a component in the block mill; it does not describe a specific globally novel coaking mechanism. Whole-system identity would be too broad; unresolved rather than deleting a component as a copy.
Cooke–Wheatstone railway engine-control telegraph differs in apparatus/application from Morse paid public messaging; no generic telegraph collapse.
Paid Morse public service provides a commercial/access event; other telegraph nodes cannot be merged without coding/apparatus/network identity checks.
Baseline abstract establishes public opening, not apparatus or new global access mechanism. O’Shaughnessy apparatus leads show non-Morse variants; exact canonical target remains unproved.
Brief failed submarine link is distinct from inland public service. The 1866 link may be a technical reliability/material improvement, not simply another date for an unchanged cable.
Durability and sustained transatlantic commercial operation may constitute reliability/access advance; exact technical comparison with failed 1858 cable needed before identity merger.

NTT/Postal Museum identify imported Breguet dial telegraphs, with local script customization. Distinct from Morse and Cooke–Wheatstone nodes; global advance beyond earlier French Breguet remains unresolved.
Subscriber switching/exchange is a new network architecture rather than point-to-point telegraph service.
Central DC station/local distribution is distinct from later three-phase long-distance AC or hydro supply; global central-station priority unproved by local-opening evidence.
Three-phase generator/transformer/motor transmission architecture differs materially from Pearl Street DC distribution.
Hydroelectric commercial supply differs in source/application/scale, but exact advance beyond Lauffen transmission requires system-phase/material/performance comparison; no regional-first deletion.
Vacuum-tube punched-tape cryptanalytic processing differs from general stored-program service and business computer configurations.
Stored-program research computer is a configuration distinct from Colossus; prototype/service stages already share one node.
Business-computing application informed by EDSAC may qualify new application/system changes; not proven an unchanged copy and no merge solely from development influence.
Scientific-language compiler is a distinct software capability rather than a stored-program hardware deployment.
Publicly available browser/server hypertext system has distinct network/software functionality; release is a lifecycle stage, not duplicate telegraph access.

A fixed concentric circular scale with radial arms differs from movable linear scales, but evidence in the record does not establish whether these features first advanced capability globally; compare earlier circular logarithmic instruments and the precise witness.

Chapter 18 states arithmetic rules operating on zero and signed quantities, not merely a positional zero placeholder. Scope to the cited rules, including known errors or uncertainties, without asserting all were globally first.
The published common-logarithm table uses a different normalization from Napier’s original table. Retain as a distinct calculational configuration; do not claim Briggs alone conceived it.

Leonardo’s testimony establishes his own instruction and links it to composing Liber abaci, but reports no new mathematical operation in the instruction. Preserve as a provenance pathway only pending an evidenced later frontier contribution of the receiving work.
A working objective-eyepiece distance-magnifying spyglass differs from Galileo’s documented later improvements and observations. No priority over every earlier optical proposal is implied.

Higher-quality convex/concave instruments used for astronomical observations have performance and practical observational configuration distinct from the 1608 spyglass; restrict to evidenced instruments.
Repeated positions and interpretation as bodies revolving around Jupiter is an empirical astronomical result distinct from telescope construction; avoid unverified exclusivity of observation.

Galileo’s repeated views and relief interpretation are distinct from the telescope, but evaluating global frontier requires comparing earlier lunar-relief accounts and contemporaneous telescopic drawings; do not remove for lack of comparison.

A physical logarithmic scale used with dividers is operationally distinct from logarithm tables; compare prior physical logarithmic lines and geometric instruments before asserting first or globally new configuration.

The surviving illustrated commentary explains Ibn al-Banna’s rules with concrete place-value addition and carry. The record does not establish that the arithmetic operation or worked format was new globally; retain textual relationship only pending a later frontier contribution.

A compact unillustrated textbook is a textual format, while place-aligned arithmetic is already in older traditions. The record does not compare the precise rules for any nontrivial mathematical advance; investigate before promotion or merger.

Indian methods were attributed to an earlier tradition, and extant numeral details derive from later Latin copies. Preserve this reconstructed source tradition as a qualified branching provenance node; no novel arithmetic is established by the stated configuration. Its anchor overlaps Dixit witness and should not count as an independent adoption.

The edition describes a Latin translation/redaction of al-Khwarizmi-derived arithmetic. A distinct manuscript or language is a transmission event, not evidence the listed decimal operations became globally new; preserve descent only pending a supported later frontier contribution. Do not merge with Liber: their separate redactions are evidenced.

Folkerts describes a separate rearranged and expanded Latin exposition of al-Khwarizmi-derived arithmetic. The present record does not identify a globally new algorithm or demonstrate one in the incomplete selected witness. Preserve branch as qualified transmission, not a proven duplicate of Dixit.

The exact stated configuration is positional notation and arithmetic procedures already present in earlier traditions. The broader work may contain further mathematical contributions or enhanced access, but those are not established as a global frontier by the current narrow configuration. Audit particular chapters and date-bearing witnesses before deciding.

Published numerical logarithms and tables constitute a computational construction distinct from the later common-logarithm normalization and instrument scales; scope to documented form, not universal exclusivity.

Newton’s prism experiments and differing-refrangibility inference are separate from the later reflective objective. Earlier dispersion observations do not by themselves establish this particular causal interpretation; assess competing claims before priority language.

A built speculum-metal reflecting telescope is materially distinct from a refracting objective and from theoretical designs. Scope to demonstrated instrument and do not imply the idea of reflection originated with Newton.

Relative sliding of logarithmic scales performs multiplication without transferring distances by dividers: a concrete mechanical operation distinct from the Gunter rule. Verify claims of sole or earliest inventor separately.

The erasable board procedures are the source configuration for the explicitly documented paper adaptation, not a novel 952 invention. Preserve the board-to-paper link as an evidence-backed antecedent; compare earlier board forms if a separate global node is proposed.

Thomann printed pp. 174–175 describes the author’s no-erasure paper adaptation, including a mixed-sign worked multiplication; this is a meaningful material and algorithmic departure from erasable board reckoning. Scope to documented adaptation and avoid unsupported priority.

The received handbook is a compilation, while the Fangcheng node isolates a specific procedure within it. Their text-container and mathematical procedure are not identical, but handbook-level novelty or necessary causality needs specific evidence.

The coefficient-column reduction procedure with signed quantities is a specific computable method rather than a text container; retain pending further global priority comparison, with the attested entry date distinguished from invention.

Chemla printed p. 21 reports a mathematical extension of chapter 8, so this record has more than copy or commentary status. Narrow the node to the evidenced extension and specify its procedure before claiming a global first.

The court presentation and layered subcommentary establish textual reception, but current evidence identifies no particular novel mathematical result in the group’s commentary. Preserve only as a potential transmission step pending demonstrated connection to a later frontier result.

The present configuration identifies a treatise through later use but does not specify which algebraic method advances earlier work. Later reuse is not itself a novelty comparison. Research exact theorem or procedure and prior art.

A commentary exists indirectly in later testimony, but present passages do not establish its detailed content or global advance. The edge shows dependency on Abu Kamil; whether it contributes to a later frontier result is unestablished, so do not assume a causal transmission role.

The museum identifies a Type III school-tablet witness and multiplication table, not a first multiplication table or novel multiplication procedure. Audit its actual entries against prior tables; do not merge a pedagogical artifact into a purported earlier configuration without an exact matching predecessor.

The inscribed sexagesimal diagonal approximation and product are concrete precision and calculation evidence, distinct from a generic multiplication table; assess prior comparable approximations before first/record assertions.

Chace identifies Ahmose’s copied text and an older source; the museum establishes a worked mathematics witness, not the origin or novelty of its complete procedures. Examine particular problems against earlier texts before a frontier decision; no exact duplicate text or dated precursor has been established here.

The documented Gwalior inscription is a later instance of decimal place-value numeral writing using a circular zero placeholder, not a distinct global advance of that configuration. Earlier Southeast Asian inscriptions exhibit zero in ciphered positional decimal notation, and Chrisomalis reports circular zero signs in Old Malay inscriptions. Preserve Gwalior as a precisely scoped later use event on the proposed broader configuration, not as an invention or a causal descendant claim.

Alternating subtraction to find a common measure is a precise algorithm, and later ancient expositions attest reception rather than a new method. Its earliest priority and the represented odd-number variant need separate evidence; preserve the event caveats.

A prime-factor procedure for a common denominator is operationally specific and may be a substantial contribution; current cited materials do not compare the full algorithm against globally earlier fraction or factorization methods. Do not conflate it with his algebra commentary or assert first use.
Franklin and Gosling’s qualified structural inferences are experimental constraints, not Watson and Crick’s complete complementary-pair model; maintain both and their evidence.
Dideoxy/analogue terminated synthesis differs chemically from plus/minus polymerase reactions and Maxam–Gilbert chemical cleavage.
Explicit antiparallel complementary paired model is not equivalent to diffraction constraints or empirical base ratios.
Purification and assay of enzyme is distinct from template-directed interpretation in 1959; review technology versus science classification separately.
Fluorescent labels on four primers with pooled gel readout differ from dye-labelled terminators used in the 1987 single-reaction approach.
Four labelled dideoxy terminators in one reaction differ from dye-labelled primers; evolutionary relationship is not identity.
An assembled human reference draft is a scientific outcome, not identical to the mapped-clone sequencing process; verify chronology and scope independently.
Mapped-clone assembly workflow and published human genome draft represent different process versus result identities; review evidence for claim of method novelty separately.
Hydration-dependent A/B diffraction observation differs from structural interpretation and full atomic model.
Specific empirical viral base-ratio measurements differ from the proposed complementary base-pair model; retain as evidence/result.
Sequence and overlapping coding result is not identical to plus/minus sequencing method.
Plus/minus enzymatic sequencing is distinguishable from chemical cleavage and chain-termination approaches.

GG2 is a named model distinct as a product identity, but this inventory does not establish a frontier-changing configuration compared with prior Glass Enterprise Edition 1; compare hardware and capabilities and scope before deciding.

Forbes’s Chichester use is a later local application of Laennec’s mediate auscultation and monaural stethoscope. Forbes translated Laennec in 1821 and studied his technique. The broader Laennec instrument/method needs a sourced graph identity and earlier event before rehoming this witness. No current-node target asserted.

Marshall’s original report explicitly names treatment under the antiseptic system and notes Lister’s sutures and plaster; Lister’s carbolic wound method was reported in 1867. Create or verify the earlier broader method identity and rehome the 1869 dated witness, rather than deleting its evidence.

The 1914 textbook is later evidence of the broader concentration-based hydrogen-ion exponent, introduced in 1909. Retain the method node and refine identity, earlier evidence, lifecycle and date; 1914 remains an entry witness, not invention.
Selective suppression to isolate B. influenzae in cultures is a diagnostic-laboratory configuration distinct from systemic therapeutic use in patients; do not merge into Oxford clinical trial.
A commercial glass-electrode vacuum-tube measuring instrument is distinct from Sørensen’s numerical pH concept.
Systemic hospital treatment is a clinical application distinct from selective bacterial culture. A trial is not proof of first approval, effective manufacturing or commercialization.

The configuration is general recombinant bacterial plasmid cloning, reported by Cohen and collaborators in 1973; the 1979 source is a later witness, not the origin. Retain and anchor/refine the broader method instead of treating the 1979 witness as a novel method.

The described base-specific chemical-cleavage sequencing method was published by Maxam and Gilbert in 1977; retain method distinct from enzymatic Sanger and refine historical identity and date. Preserve 1979 witness.

The described hybridoma antibody use in distinguishing human T cell populations was documented by Reinherz et al. in 1979 using OKT4; retain coherent specific application, refine earlier anchor and retain 1980 source as later use.

Recombinant human insulin marketed as Humulin is distinct from the general plasmid cloning technique and laboratory insulin expression; resolve conflicting 1982 launch versus 1983 first sale accounts rather than equate approval with sale.

Configuration is general Taq-based PCR rather than an immunology-specific invention; Saiki et al. 1988 documents same general method. Retain/refine identity and anchor, and retain 1989 immunology report as use witness.

Shalem 2013 online/2014 issue already used genome-scale Cas9 screening to identify genes essential to viability in human cancer and stem cells. Hart reports a higher-complexity second-generation library and improved Bayesian analysis across five lines. Decide whether the defined high-resolution improvement meets frontier scope; the broad use alone is a duplicate, but do not erase a demonstrable improvement without comparative review.

A field-integrated sequencing and diagnostic-laboratory surveillance workflow is distinct from the portable sequencing instrument, but uniqueness and priority versus earlier viral genomic surveillance/portable deployments require comparison. 2015 Guinea deployment is a witness, not proof of invention.
Enzymatic copying interpretation and experimental support differ from polymerase purification/assay and from a later particular sequencing workflow.

content.limits: This is an exhaustive identity screening, not exhaustive worldwide-priority research. Every baseline assertion and its evidence pointers were inspected; live sources were rechecked for the high-risk shortlist and regional/museum cases. Entries without original source reinspection explicitly say so. Only the two supported identity duplicates have executable replacement proposals. Missing novelty evidence is unresolved and never counted as proof of duplication.

decisions.reason: The documented Gwalior inscription is a later instance of decimal place-value numeral writing using a circular zero placeholder, not a distinct global advance of that configuration. Earlier Southeast Asian inscriptions exhibit zero in ciphered positional decimal notation, and Chrisomalis reports circular zero signs in Old Malay inscriptions. Preserve Gwalior as a precisely scoped later use event on the proposed broader configuration, not as an invention or a causal descendant claim.
decisions.configuration: A stone inscription uses small circular zero placeholders in decimal numbers, including 270 and 50, in a garden and garland account.

entry-electronics-japan-tokyo-yokohama-1.comparison: The asserted service used imported Breguet step-dial instruments. Powerhouse and the German postal museum describe earlier Breguet alphabetical step dials on French railways by 1850. NTT reports original dials had blank rows for national languages, in which Japanese operators wrote iroha; sender crank and receiver pointer communicated positions, with row selection by a pause. The German museum describes substitution of katakana for letters. Those sources positively support applying an existing slot-and-row symbol mechanism to a different script; they do not establish a new electrical encoder, line, receiver, or performance advantage. Public telegram availability already existed by Washington–Baltimore 1845 (and Paddington–Slough 1843, qualified as a publicity exercise). Preserve localized script and Japanese service as important regional access context; do not claim all Japanese and French dial variants were identical or that no earlier non-Latin instrument existed. The NTT reconstruction has 24 positions while the original is 26; do not treat replica as historical design.
entry-electronics-japan-tokyo-yokohama-1.causal_disposition: The snapshot has no incident relationships, and no particular Japanese event is shown to enable a later global frontier result. Preserve full original node, event, sources and local-language adaptation in CURRENT exclusion context. No canonical target or Morse merge.
entry-electronics-japan-tokyo-yokohama-1.chronology_qualification: Japan Postal Museum says 1869, while ITU says 1870. Postal archive account gives Meiji 2, 12th month, 25th day, converted to 26 January 1870; this suggests a calendar-year source of discrepancy, but the museum text does not state its 1869 conversion method. Do not silently resolve without original-date confirmation.

deferred_cases.reason: Slough–Paddington opened for public messages in 1843 (source is a specialist secondary reconstruction describing a publicity exercise, so not automatically equivalent to a sustained public postal service). This precedes 1845 broadly as public access, but US case specifies a Morse-code line and Post Office paid service; compare earlier public use of actual Morse apparatus and post-office operational model before excluding. Do not merge Morse and Cooke–Wheatstone instruments.

A French Breguet alphabetical one-wire step-by-step dial existed by 1850 and Japan used imported dials with Japanese-character modification in 1869. Dial mechanism, ease of use and relative construction cost were prior instrument attributes, not established Japanese breakthroughs. The script adaptation is real; do not assume it is globally first or technically inconsequential. Target global earlier non-Latin dials and precise alteration. Japan Postal Museum states public Tokyo–Yokohama in 1869; ITU says 1870, NTT distinguishes 1869 circuits and 1870 service. Public date unresolved; do not silently change node date.

Earlier 1837 Euston–Camden demonstration and 1839 Paddington–West Drayton line used Cooke–Wheatstone equipment; 1839 railway arrival/departure control may precede Blackwall. Blackwall’s exact application relayed instructions to cable-haulage winding engines, not merely train-block messaging. Earlier Euston trial in 1837 was proposed for rope-haulage signalling; evidence inspected does not establish that it was used in actual railway operations. Investigate earlier operating electric winding-engine control and causal enabling evidence before disposition.

Lauffen 1891 used three-phase hydro generation and long-distance transmission for exhibition lights and motor. 1896 Niagara used two-phase generators, transformer conversion to three-phase transmission and rotary conversion to DC traction at Buffalo, with 1000 hp under contract. Different phase conversion, traction and commercial service; do not infer global first on that basis. Search earlier matching commercial 2-phase-to-3-phase transmission and DC traction use.

Compare its three-phase hydroelectric generation, step-up/down and long-distance exhibition application with earlier full systems. Niagara was later and a different power conversion and commercial traction configuration.

Local DC central station and distribution to customers cannot be merged with AC long-distance hydroelectric systems. Search earlier commercially supplied central incandescent lighting with matching generation, distribution, metering and load architecture, including Edison Holborn 1882, before deciding.

content.reason: The exact node asserts regional telegraph service; evidence identifies Breguet pointer apparatus used in Japan. The German postal museum reports earlier Breguet pointer service on French railways in 1850, and NTT describes blank language rows and their Japanese iroha use; the German museum corroborates katakana replacement. This supports application of an existing symbol-slot mechanism for local script, not a demonstrated novel global communication mechanism. Preserve script adaptation in full historical context. No claim of identical every mechanical detail, first non-Latin transmission, absence of all Japanese innovation, or equivalence to Morse.

# Process comparison decisions

## Linz soft blowing and 1952 production: defer merger

The 1966 district-court opinion, I.B, links larger-scale tests and the 1952 production of the same vertical oxygen process to earlier Linz tests. This establishes process lineage, not equivalence of capacity and industrial configuration. The developer's retrospective history, printed p.11, identifies the 2-tonne June 1949 experimental converter and a purpose-built 15-tonne experimental converter first used 2 October 1949; printed p.28 says LD Steelworks 1 had two crucibles in 1952/53 and three 30-tonne crucibles after a third was added in 1956. The precise 1952 starting vessel capacity is not established by that retrospective wording. ASME's 1985 landmark history, PDF pp.4–5, connects successful 2-ton converter trials and improved technical information to construction of production plants. This is affirmative evidence of substantial scale development, potentially an independent frontier advance. Retain both nodes until contemporaneous plant records or engineering studies establish actual 1952 vessel size, plant system and scaling innovations, and compare those to the pre-1952 global state. Do not infer a distinct architecture solely from larger tonnage or claim the identified production plant was globally first without broader research. Preserve the 1949 trial-to-1952 production relationship and events.

## Soho experimental engine and broad separate-condenser arrangement: defer merger

Andrew 2009, printed pp.14–15, traces Watt's earlier unsatisfactory 18-inch cylinder, the replacement Wilkinson cylinder, Soho-made smaller parts and promising 1775 trials. It discusses machining accuracy but infers the likely boring method and does not supply measured error or a direct record of the particular machine. This supports an improvement in the trial configuration, not mere geography; actual precision and operational reliability relative to the 1765 surviving model and other earlier engines need explicit evidence. The broad target's configuration subsumes all separate-condensing arrangements, but common principle alone does not establish equivalence of configurations under the frontier criteria. Preserve the 1775 trial and later 1854 public-disclosure event and the component and development links pending comparison of sealing, cylinder geometry, experimental performance, and earlier relevant engines. Do not claim the model and Soho engine are physically identical or conflate a component with the whole engine.

notes.comparison: The Fibonacci prologue reports learning calculation with Indian figures in Bugia before his 1202 composition. Folkerts records earlier ninth-century al-Khwarizmi-derived and 952–953 al-Uqlidisi arithmetic. The latter establish a prior tradition, but do not invalidate this particular documented learning pathway.
notes.causal_comparison: The author explicitly connects instruction and further study to his composition of Liber abaci; that is more than a hypothetical channel. Its particular later global-frontier contribution remains unresolved, and the policy does not require the lesson to be uniquely necessary.
notes.next_research: Examine Liber abaci’s specific candidate contributions, earlier comparators and their links to the reported instruction; retain node and edge pending that result.

notes.comparison: Folkerts dates the al-Khwarizmi arithmetic source to the ninth century and describes a later Latin reworking. His chapter 2 lists Dixit’s integer, fraction and square-root operations in the older Arabic-derived arithmetic tradition. These are different textual forms; neither translation nor regional access is denied.
notes.causal_comparison: Its sole current edge is textual descent from al-Khwarizmi; Folkerts documents wider influence on later algorism texts, but this graph does not bind the specific copyist or redaction to a specified later global-frontier result. The existing copyist anchor does not by itself establish broader practical access.

notes.comparison: Folkerts chapter 2 compares Liber Alchorismi to the al-Khwarizmi-derived Dixit on the same broad integer, fraction and root operations; its order differs and exposition is fuller and sometimes clearer. That establishes repeated arithmetic topics while distinguishing the works; it does not establish manuscript identity.
notes.causal_comparison: Its sole incident edge is the distinct adaptation from the Arabic-derived tradition. The selected Oxford copy is incomplete and current evidence only demonstrates copyist access; it does not show the presence of every enumerated method in that copy or a particular later global-frontier result.

notes.comparison: NYU dates school tablet B6063 broadly to the Old Babylonian 19th–17th centuries BCE and identifies its Type III classroom form. Robson documents standard multiplication-table series and student-tablet types in Old Babylonian schools. The earlier Early Dynastic square/area tables are not established as identical multiplication-table layout or pedagogy.
notes.causal_comparison: A standard school practice and examples of the same broad period do not prove a specifically earlier identical multiplication-table configuration, nor do they establish a later frontier role for B6063 itself.
notes.next_research: Transliterate B6063’s table and compare its head number, progression, layout and school role with individually dated earlier Old Babylonian and Ur III multiplication-table witnesses; establish actual relative chronology rather than assuming it from period-wide dating.

notes.comparison: The Rhind papyrus introduction says it was copied from old writings of the time of Amenemhat III. Hollings and Parkinson interpret it as a copy of a text roughly two centuries older, and state that it contains over 80 arithmetic and geometry problems. The older composition itself is unavailable for a complete line-by-line comparison.
notes.causal_comparison: A reported older source is concrete evidence for transmission; it does not independently establish the exact wording or technique of every individual problem, or eliminate the possibility of later alterations. No later global-frontier causal connection is established by this comparison.
notes.next_research: Compare specific Rhind problems and unit-fraction procedures with the Moscow papyrus, mathematical leather roll and other dateable sources, using critical editions and allowing uncertain manuscript dates; identify actual overlapping or distinct procedures.
